description.narrative:
Interpeace Somali Programme has two components: Pillars of Peace and democratization. Hence the two components have separete but connected visions.
The vision of Pillars of Peace is to build social cohesion and goodwill in the societies of Somaliland, Puntland and south central Somalia by providing a peacebuilding perspective to nuance and underpin the ongoing statebuilding processes taking place in these regions.
The vision of the Democratisation programme is to realise a stronger and more stable Somali Region by supporting a peaceful and locally-owned process of democratisation in Somaliland and Puntland.
Stöd till Interpeace fredsbyggnad- och demokratiseringsprogram Denna andra fasen av Pillars of Peace kommer att genomföra de rekommendationer och slutsatser från programmets första fas.
Support to the Interpeace peace-building and democratizationprogramme. This is the second phase of the Pillars of Peace, which will implement the recommendations outlined by the first phase.
